info.name: Qovery Account Info Organization Event API
Get all events inside the organization

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of events to display in the current page

params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description:
Display events triggered since this timestamp.  
A range of date can be specified by using `from-timestamp` with `to-timestamp`
The format is a timestamp with nano precision

params.name: toTimestamp
params.description:
Display events triggered before this timestamp.  
A range of date can be specified by using `to-timestamp` with `from-timestamp`
The format is a timestamp with nano precision

params.name: continueToken
params.description:
Token used to fetch the next page results
The format is a timestamp with nano precision

params.name: stepBackToken
params.description:
Token used to fetch the previous page results
The format is a timestamp with nano precision

params.name: targetId
params.description:
The target resource id to search.  
Must be specified with the corresponding `target_type`

params.name: triggeredBy
params.description: Information about the owner of the event (user name / apitoken / automatic action)

params.name: serviceProjectId
params.description: The project chosen when filtering on a service type

params.name: serviceEnvironmentId
params.description: The environment chosen when filtering on a service type

items.docs: Get all events inside the organization

info.name: Get available event targets to filter events

params.name: fromTimestamp
params.description:
Display targets available since this timestamp.  
A range of date can be specified by using `from-timestamp` with `to-timestamp`
The format is a timestamp with nano precision

params.name: toTimestamp
params.description:
Display targets triggered before this timestamp.  
A range of date can be specified by using `to-timestamp` with `from-timestamp`
The format is a timestamp with nano precision

params.name: triggeredBy
params.description: Information about the owner of the event (user name / apitoken / automatic action)

params.name: projectId
params.description: Mandatory when requesting an environment or a service

params.name: targetLevelToFetch
params.description: Used only to retrieve projects or environments linked to service typed events

items.docs: Get available event targets to filter events
